claims.title: P2 Gao assessment: conservation is accounting;use the corrected heating-value frontier

quoted_fields.interface: P2 rejects conservation accounting as a useful Doob-control bridge for the Gao CO2-to-methane reactor. Charge/carbon bounds do not identify selectivity or the preferred external command. Standard command-policy likelihood needs the same physical response kernel and positive support;an equally informed ordinary controller ties. Catalyst inventory normalization is an unbuilt candidate;complete-cycle energy/output improvement over the strong source remains unresolved.
quoted_fields.failure: No physical recovery apparatus,measured Cu loss/recovery,selectivity reset,500h asymmetric-pulse result,full-cycle improvement,novelty or independent scientific review is earned. The separate full research bundle was not acquired. Original heating-value labels are corrected by the supplied linked notice:55.5MJ/kg is approximate HHV,not LHV.
